svg.title: P16: Hooks and event bus collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A1/A3 · hub role collaboration
Harness lifecycle emits named events or hook
A model, tool, turn, or agent event is published.
Event schema, registration, handler ordering, and
Registered handlers observe or transform behavior
Event names and payload schemas are stable
Handler order and whether a result may be
A handler cannot create an undetected
Handler failure and reentrancy have defined
1 emit(event) → 2 resolve(order) → 3 invoke(hook) → 4 continue(event) → 5 dispatch(event) → 6 return(result)
Evidence: 34/41 repositories, 31/36 families; 34 trajectories (18 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Hook registry, event bus, observer, middleware, and priority.
Negative control: A direct logging statement is not an extensible hook.
